messages.subject: Middle East Energy & Natural Resources Leadership | ESG, Government Relations and Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear Marlin Hawk Team,

I am introducing my profile for senior Middle East mandates across energy, natural resources, mining, industrial transformation and country-facing leadership. Your Dubai practice, including the International Industrials and Middle East/Africa focus across energy, natural resources and infrastructure, is closely aligned with my background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy, executive advisory and cross-functional execution within a major multinational mining operation.

My strongest value is at the intersection of international investment, government priorities, regulation, stakeholder trust and operational execution. I also support the institutional dimension of a large industrial solar and battery-storage programme, giving me practical exposure to energy transition and infrastructure delivery.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE. I would welcome confidential consideration for Director, Senior Director, Country Director or Representative, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across energy, natural resources, mining, industrial and infrastructure organisations.

My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop

messages.subject: Mining & Metals Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations and Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Smallwood,

Enable Group's specialist focus on global mining and metals talent makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG and sustainability, social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy, executive advisory and cross-functional coordination within a major gold-mining operation.

My profile is strongest for leadership mandates where mining companies need someone who can protect licence to operate, navigate regulators and government, strengthen institutional and community trust, support major capital programmes and translate corporate commitments into credible local execution. I also support the stakeholder interface around AGM's industrial solar and battery-storage programme.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Executive Operations roles across mining, metals, critical minerals and related infrastructure. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE, and I remain open to international mining jurisdictions.

My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
